## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs:`)
- [ ] Refactor / chore (`refactor:` / `chore:`)
- [ ] Tests (`test:`)

## Related issues

<!-- e.g. "Closes #123" — or "n/a" -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Branched off `main` and using a Conventional Commit title
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass (or the relevant Go / frontend checks)
- [ ] Docs updated for any user-facing change
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or generated artifacts committed
